|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Elegant Lightsaber]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-85-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Elegant Lightsaber]] (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); [[Elegant Lightsaber (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Elegant Lightsaber (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Elegant Lightsaber]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on a Jedi. May add 1 to Force drain at opponent's site where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition If total destiny > defense value.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 86. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=53, page 53. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=53 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “86” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Elegant Lightsaber (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) moved the condition to the front of the hit clause: “Deploy on a Jedi. May add 1 to Force drain at opponent's site where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > defense value, target hit and may not be used to satisfy attrition.”.<ref name="cl-1250_85-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Elegant Lightsaber (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-elegantlightsaber-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Elegant Lightsaber]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on a Jedi. May add 1 to Force drain at opponent's site where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition If total destiny > defense value.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual5-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual5-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “86” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 53)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Elegant Lightsaber]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on a Jedi. May add 1 to Force drain at opponent's site where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition If total destiny > defense value.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-85-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “86”).
